correctness.rationale: Any real projection onto specified V has form UF with FU=I. Frozen exact U,F_star give FU=I and all five absolute row sums 845/659. For perturbations H with HU=0, seven signed supporting row-sum forms L_i satisfy positive barycentric identity sum_i c_i L_i=0 and injective map of six-dimensional tangent onto that hyperplane (rank 10 after four constraints). Thus g=max L_i is positive and g<=1 is a seven-vertex simplex. Independently recreated rational system in SymPy using P_star signs: all seven vertices nondegenerate, their ||U H_i|| are 1013/104, 493257/1508, 9739/572, 2909/104, 2909/104, 493257/1508, 9739/572; max K yields global strong uniqueness modulus 1508/493257. Exact t=1/100000 perturbation at extremal vertex gives equality, so constant is sharp. This is a finite exact certificate combined with universal convexity, not sampling.
